edge_meaning: Edges point from cited input to consumer. JOINT_INPUT is conjunctive; ALTERNATIVE_INPUT names an alternative for the same consumer. CONTEXT_ONLY has zero inferential weight. No status propagation.

A-X.statement: actual fixed-source X=Pi*j. forall epsilon>0, integral_0_infty exp(-2 epsilon t)|X(t)|^2 dt < infinity

ACTUAL_FIELD_TRANSFER.statement: The all-damping bound on the original prime field suffices for RH.

ACTUAL_UPPER.statement: On complete native shells and the original signs, prove an independent cofinal bound for every positive exponent on the positive or negative weighted sum of squared residual node counts; include used donors, boundary regimes and actual quantifiers. Then discharge the native transfer and exact formal claim gates.

APERTURE.statement: The fixed K5 carrier yields a signed aperture integral with local divisor bounds and a zero-sensitive one-sided criterion. Finite comparison, parity projection and frequency averaging leave a genuine uniform arithmetic upper open.

AREA_ECHO.statement: Positive xi averages force negative weighted and ordinary-prime area excursions, including the deterministic next prime-power term. A weighted prime-factor criterion and finite critical integral bound do not establish negativity at every late cutoff.

AREA_LOCALIZATION.statement: Factorial and eta projections reconstruct the centered area from explicit old-prime ranges with signed weights. The eta version is unconditional in its stated cutoff range. Stronger factorial power localization uses the supplied project zero ceiling.

AREA_ROWS.statement: Disjoint prime summation ranges provide two coupled reconstructions with controlled row energy and signed shared-product covariance. Both use related Möbius coefficient systems. Disjoint outer variables give no independence.

AREA_SIGNS.statement: At a hypothetical rightward zero, true integrated ordinary-prime errors take both signs in prescribed late windows. Zero-density isolators, attained vs unattained edge and signed filter cost distinguish uniform power windows from constant ratio windows.

A_SIGNED_OBSERVATION.statement: Complete signed observation estimate including all cross terms and recovery budgets. OPEN_FULL_SOURCE_ANALYTIC_ESTIMATE No complete new Lean route contract is supplied by this extension

B-Y.statement: actual Yepsilon for native convolution Aepsilon. forall epsilon>0, Yepsilon in closure(range(Aepsilon))

BAND.statement: A pooled true signed row and localized fixed-height energies retain a rightward displacement. A sharp fixed-frequency prefix can detect remote zeros, so verified low-height zero freedom does not give its critical upper. Finite checked ranges are bounded.

B_CAUSAL.statement: Actual source-preserving causal Gram residual tends to zero. OPEN_FULL_SOURCE_ANALYTIC_ESTIMATE No complete new Lean route contract is supplied by this extension

C-Schur.statement: complete same-detector signed Schur loss with full complement and known shift. Source-specific subexponential upper law on all selectors returned by the registered producer, with all constants and quantifiers explicit

C1_COFINAL_MOMENT_SLICES.statement: CofinalMomentSliceVanishingErrorBounds. for every n>=1 an aperture L>=n+2 and one parity covering its entire moment slice at the literal quartic cutoff with tolerance 1/n Read full compiler-exported Lean type; metadata is not a substitute

C2_ACTUAL_LONG_TERM_LOWER.statement: Eventual constant lower bound on the literal native long term. exists C>0 and T before every t>=T Premise is stated inline in its consumer

COMPLETE_WEIGHTED_UPPER.statement: For every η>0 fix Cη before the lower horizon R. Find T≥max(R,16) with the integrated complete signed prime-power response, weighted by exp(−(T−t)/2), at most Cη exp(ηT).

CONE_CONTINGENCY.statement: The actual sign and small-cofactor cone give a 2×2 interaction determinant with positive normalized mass of order X^(1−o(1)) on base cells in a whole shell comparable with X. The complementary signed marginal product compensates it. The finite audit checks both exact integer identities.

CONE_MATCH.statement: At aligned horizons, matching actual primes and small-cofactor rows against opposite-sign donors pays a graph decrement, including the stated cofactor regime and signed correction. The polynomial extension requires exact retained-neighbor accounting.

CR01.parameter_order: n first; then L and the parity; then every slice vector. No fixed parity, rank, gap or bound between selected apertures.
CR01.statement: (C1) cofinal vanishing-error moment-slice bounds. For every n>=1 there is an aperture L>=n+2 and one parity whose entire moment slice at K=originalDetectorQuarticCutoff(L) satisfies Q_p(L,x) >= -(1/n)||x||^2 in the inherited physical norm.

CR02.parameter_order: R before L; the restriction must hold on the eligible packet outputs themselves or one output must carry both packet properties and the restriction.
CR02.statement: Selected-packet ground-response restriction. At late disjoint native states at the literal quartic cutoff, the corrected cubic source on the strictly lower negative even ground ray and the odd adjoint pairing on the strictly lower negative odd ground ray are both below one.

CR03.parameter_order: C and T before every t.
CR03.statement: (C2) actual long-term eventual lower bound. There exist C>0 and T such that for all t>=T, hyperbolaT(actualCorrelationLogarithmicTest t)(actualCorrelationCutoff t/2) >= -C.

CR04.parameter_order: Eventual in L; constants independent of L.
CR04.statement: Native K3 ordinary-prime remainder E_ord. An eventual polynomial lower bound on either literal K3 scalar energy, equivalently control of E_ord = B_1 + 200 a beta^2 L + d_0 (H_2+16) L^2.

CR05.statement: Qualified causal alternative. The actual source-preserving causal Gram residual tends to zero.

CR06.statement: Fixed off-line-zero margin on both moment slices. Under an actual off-line zero there is d>0 such that eventually both slices contain nonzero literal trials with Q_p < -d||x||^2.

CR07.statement: Exact slice dimensions and nonvacuity. dim even slice = K-3 and dim odd slice = K-4 (natural subtraction) for K>=2; at K=ceil(L^4)>=16 the slices have dimension at least 13 and 12.

CR08.statement: Physical congruence transport and frame comparisons. Slice bounds are exactly seed-coordinate bounds with the full Gram D^2; a coordinate tolerance eps gives physical eps/beta^2; a physical tolerance eps gives coordinate eps (beta+K^2)^2.

CR09.statement: Disjoint spectra exclude every bottom tie. Where the full even and odd native spectra are disjoint, the two Rayleigh bottoms differ.

CR10.statement: Inverse-residual block certificate (C3). A >= a > 0 and D - CX - X*C* + X*AX - a^{-1} R*R >= 0 with R = C* - AX imply the complete block is PSD; the exact form identity with A^{-1} holds.

CR11.statement: Finite source-core consumer (C4). Leakage eta <= eps/4 against the full complement and core form >= -(11 eps/12) imply H + eps I >= 0; column form keeps the nonorthogonal Gram.

CR12.statement: Negative-witness transport (E2). A trial with margin d and leakage eta < d/3 has a nonzero projected core component with margin d - 3 eta.

CR13.statement: K3 Archimedean gap. A_Gamma(L) > 0 for every L > 0.

CR14.statement: Trace formula for the core residual. eta^2 = ||(I-P)H||_F^2 = tr(H^2) - tr(G_I^{-1}(H^4)_{II}).

CR15.statement: Universal approximate-kernel mixed estimate. Paper-level dimension and mixed-operator estimate behind the source-core reduction.

CR16.statement: Fixed fractional saving against the positive K3 sector. B_1 >= -kappa (A_Gamma + B_{>=2}) eventually with fixed kappa < 1.

CR17.statement: Pole channel vanishes on both carriers. The pole kernel is S(u u^T - v v^T) with u_n = L/d_n and v_n = 4 pi n/d_n; parity kills one profile and pole neutrality the other, so the pole energy is identically zero on both pole-neutral carriers. The native energy there is exactly -arch - prime.

CR18.statement: Channel-separated supplier. lambda_min(-arch) + lambda_min(-prime) >= -1/n on the slice.

CR19.statement: Scalar inverse-gap supplier on the Fourier-prefix split. D - a^-1 C C^T >= 0 for some a <= lambda_min(A).

CR20.statement: Shifted-prefix quarter gap, high-support unshifted gap and upper cap (separate identities). lambda_min(A_eps) >= 1/4 persists; A <= 9 persists.

CR21.statement: Degree-m coupled polynomial certificate at the (C1) checkpoints. X = P_m(A) C^T in blockEnergy_nonneg_of_inverse_residual_certificate supplies the (C1) checkpoint at a tested degree m(n, L).

CR22.statement: Near-null count law. The number of slice eigenvalues below a fixed small threshold (1e-2 to 1e-13) equals dim - N(2 pi K/L) up to O(log T).

CR23.statement: Near-band coupling mass. The coupling C from the low slice block into the near-null directions of the complement block (eigenvalues of A within 1e-6 of eps) has total mass far below the scalar-gap charge.

CR24.statement: Detection threshold of off-line quartets at finite checkpoints. A checkpoint at tolerance eps and aperture L detects an off-line quartet of depth delta iff c(L) delta^2 >~ eps, with c(L) increasing in L.

CR25.statement: Channel-separable control of -arch and -prime on the near-null subspace. Bounds -arch >= -kappa_A and -prime >= -kappa_P on V with kappa_A + kappa_P smaller than the required tolerance.

CR26.statement: Stability of slice positivity under prime-cell truncation. The slice form -arch - prime_{q <= P} stays above -eps for some P < Q.

CR27.statement: Inverse residual dominates the geometric tail at the same exact degree. For 0 < aI <= A <= bI, T = I - A/b, q = 1 - a/b and the exact polynomial action, S_IR - S_tail >= 0.

CR28.statement: Compressed commutator with all leakage terms. [Vᴴ D0 V, Vᴴ E V] = Vᴴ[D0,E]V + Z Lᴴ - L Zᴴ whenever (1 - V Vᴴ) D0 V = W Lᴴ and D0, E are self-adjoint.

CR29.statement: Exact-data soundness of the shifted-factor certificate. 0 < tau and ||A - tau I - R Rᵀ||²_F < tau² imply xᵀAx > 0 for x ≠ 0; tau > 0 is necessary.

CR30.statement: Source-column Gram and discarded-sector trace identities. For C = H S with invertible G = CᴴC: G = Sᴴ H² S, Cᴴ H C = Sᴴ H³ S, P = C G⁻¹ Cᴴ is a self-adjoint idempotent and tr(((1-P)H)ᴴ((1-P)H)) = tr(H²) - tr(G⁻¹ Sᴴ H⁴ S).

CR31.parameter_order: parity, C, d, L0 before L and u.
CR31.statement: (PG) fixed-parity polynomial lower bound on the moment slices. Exists a parity p, C > 0, d : Nat and L0 with Q_p(L,u) >= -C (1+L)^d ||u||^2 for every u in M_p(L,K(L)) and every L >= L0.

CR32.parameter_order: parity before alpha; C and L0 after alpha; all late L.
CR32.statement: (SE) fixed-parity subexponential lower bound. Exists p such that for every alpha > 0 there are C, L0 with Q_p(L,u) >= -C exp(alpha L) ||u||^2 for all L >= L0.

CR33.statement: Fixed-rate partial exclusion. A fixed-parity bound -C exp(alpha L) at every late aperture, alpha >= 0, gives |Re rho - 1/2| <= alpha for every zero.

CR34.statement: (SB) cofinal one-constant floor and the all-late fixed-depth witnesses (AD). Exists C >= 0 such that for every R some L > max R 2 has a parity with Q_p >= -C ||u||^2 on the whole slice.

CR35.parameter_order: alpha, then C and T; every late t.
CR35.statement: (C2-SE) literal long-term subexponential lower bound. For every alpha > 0, T(t) >= -C exp(alpha t) at every late t, T the literal hyperbola long term.

CR36.statement: (NC) native squared-index commutator cancellation and rank-one leakage. V* [D0, A] V = 0 for boundary-flat columns (full canonical source); D0 maps each slice into pole-neutral boundary-flat vectors and leaves it exactly through M6 (even) or M7 (odd).

CR37.statement: (SG) geometry-diagonal and source-response growth (5A candidate). In one fixed parity, for all late L: ||V* E w|| <= C_z (1+L)^a and min_i <v_i, H v_i> >= -C_h (1+L)^b, with v_i the geometry eigenbasis of J = V* D0 V and w the unit leakage normal.

CR38.source_disposition: OPEN (reduction CP -> PG DERIVED, not formalized)
CR38.statement: (CP) centered ordinary-prime discrepancy lower bound. In one fixed parity, for all late L and every slice vector f: D_theta(L, f) >= -C (1+L)^d ||f||^2, where Q_L = R_0 + D_theta - P_pp exactly, R_0 >= c_* ||f||^2 (c_* about -1.3722) and ||P_pp|| <= 2 L^2.

CR39.parameter_order: a sequence; no uniform bound or rate.
CR39.statement: CAUSAL: Abel-output membership at a damping sequence. Distinct lambda_j > 0, lambda_j -> 0, with H_lambda_j in L2(0, infinity) for every j.

CR40.statement: Native rank-one leakage factor and rank-two compressed commutator. D0 u - P_S D0 u = (M6(u)/||r_e||^2) r_e (even), (M7(u)/||r_o||^2) r_o (odd); <u, P D0 P A v - P A P D0 v> = c(v) conj<r, A u> - conj(c(u)) <r, A v> for the full canonical source.

CR41.parameter_order: parity, C, d, L0 before L.
CR41.statement: Reconstruction bound and the (SG) certificate consumer. Re x*Hx >= (h0 - 2 n_z n_l / g)||x||^2 under the rank-two relation; a geometry-response certificate gives the slice bound at its floor; polynomial certificates at every late aperture in one parity give PG and RH.

CR42.statement: Paid proper-prime-power adapter. ||P_pp(L)|| <= 2 L^2 on either compressed slice; PG holds for the full source iff it holds for the primes-only source.

CR43.statement: Unconditional explicit-PNT all-vector bound. Q_L(f) >= [c_* - (1 + 4 pi K/L)(3 + (939/40) L^(303/200) e^(L/2 - 0.8274 sqrt L))] ||f||^2 (Johnston-Yang input).

CR44.closing_relevance: RATE_LADDER_ADAPTER (closing only at a = 0, which is RH itself)
CR44.parameter_order: a first; then alpha > a; then C and L0; all vectors.
CR44.statement: Graded rate equivalence: zero strip and fixed-rate native floor. For a >= 0 and each parity: every nontrivial zero has |Re rho - 1/2| <= a if and only if, for every alpha > a, the fixed-rate moment-slice bound at rate alpha holds at every large aperture. The new direction has explicit constants: on every boundary-flat native vector x at aperture L and cutoff K, Re<Q x, x> >= -S e^(aL) L (1 + (2 pi K/L)^2)^2 (2K + 1) ||x||^2 with S = sum m_rho/(1 + |gamma_rho|^2).

CR45.parameter_order: One aperture and one depth D; any packet.
CR45.statement: Least-crossing cutoff at the first native space. If the cutoff-3 global pole-neutral bottom is below -D/2 (for instance one unit vector of either one-dimensional cutoff-3 parity space has energy below -D/2), every NativeDeepThresholdGroundData packet at that aperture has cutoff 3 and both predecessor spaces have dimension zero.

CR46.parameter_order: delta and beta before L; cofinal in L.
CR46.statement: Target consolidation: (U), (F) and (E) are one growth bound for the prime field Z. Under a hypothetical off-line zero of displacement delta, for every beta < delta there are arbitrarily late apertures where a cutoff-3 unit vector has energy below -e^(beta L); there the least-crossing cutoff is 3, the predecessor is {0}, and (E) is the plain L2 growth bound for Z at horizon L - c0. (F) is the weighted L2 growth bound because ||N v_L||^2 tends to ||U||^2 > 0. (U) is the weighted L1 growth bound. At rate eta each excludes zeros of displacement above eta and is implied by their absence.

CR47.closing_relevance: CLOSING_IF_SUPPLIED (RH-equivalent scalar interface; a reformulation, not an independent supplier)
CR47.parameter_order: One explicit sequence of numbers indexed by L.
CR47.statement: Scalar criterion on the even cutoff-3 energy. Let E_e(L) be the canonical energy of the unit vector of the even cutoff-3 pole-neutral boundary-flat space; its transform is R(z) = c_e (z^2 - 1/4)/(z prod_{a<=3}(z^2 + (2 pi a/L)^2)). Then sup Re rho - 1/2 is the least exponential rate at which E_e is bounded below. RH holds iff E_e(L) >= 0 for all large L, and under RH 0 < E_e(L) <= 12.94/L^5. The same holds for the odd vector.

CR48.parameter_order: Every L; the bound degrades like e^(L/2).
CR48.statement: Explicit floor with a verification height. If every zero below height H0 is on the line and theta0 = sup Re rho, then for every aperture, cutoff and boundary-flat vector c: E(c) >= -2 (2 pi)^6 S6(H0) (K^6/L^5) e^((theta0 - 1/2) L) |c|^2, S6(H0) = sum over gamma > H0 of gamma^-6. With the published height 3e12 the constant is about 4.4e-58, and with theta0 <= 1 the floor on the whole quartic carrier stays above -1 up to L about 86.

CR49.closing_relevance: NOT_CLOSING (real-rootedness of finite ground states does not distinguish RH from its failure)
CR49.statement: Native real-root lemma. If the bottom eigenvalue of the canonical form on a native space (full, boundary-flat, pole-neutral or moment slice) in one parity sector is simple, every zero z of the numerator of the ground transform has z^2 real.

CR50.closing_relevance: CLOSING_IF_SUPPLIED (the natural proof consumes canonical positivity)
CR50.statement: Ground-state convergence candidate (CT). For a sequence L_j tending to infinity with simple even bottoms: if the normalised ground transforms converge locally uniformly to xi(1/2 + z), then RH (by CR49 and Hurwitz).

CR51.closing_relevance: SHARP_INTERFACE (closing iff the descent inequality is supplied)
CR51.parameter_order: Costs A, G, h first; then the start L1 >= 1; then every large L and every eps >= 0.
CR51.statement: Loss-tolerant delay descent is a sharp interface. Abstractly (fixed_rate_of_delay_descent): if P L eps is monotone in eps, holds with C0 e^(alpha L) from L1 on, and at every large L a bound eps on [L1, L - h(L)] gives P L (A(L) + G(L) eps), with h eventually >= h0 > 0, A eventually below every positive exponential rate and 2 G(L) <= e^(eta h(L)) eventually for every eta > 0, then P holds at every positive rate from L1 on. Natively (EvenDelayDescent, OddDelayDescent): with such costs the delay descent of the slice bottom in one parity gives (SE) and RH; under RH every eventually nonnegative cost profile satisfies it.

CR52.parameter_order: theta, C, d, m first; then every large L and every eps >= 0.
CR52.statement: Fractional-scale descent with polynomial costs is a sharp interface. For 0 < theta < 1, C >= 0 and exponents d, m: the slice bound eps at theta L giving the slice bound C(1+L)^d + C(1+L)^m eps at L, at every large L in one parity (EvenScaleDescent, OddScaleDescent), is equivalent to RH. It is an instance of CR51 with delay (1 - theta) L.

CR53.statement: Tame integer drive and wild Moebius part: the exact Abel-Mertens bridge. For the fixed cutoff-4 kernel q4 = g * g, S(T) = sum_{n <= e^T} Lambda(n) n^(-1/2) q4(T - log n) equals int_0^T m(v) J(T - v) dv with m(v) = e^(-v/2) M(e^v), J = H' + H/2 and H(t) = sum_{n <= e^t} (log n / sqrt n) q4(t - log n); |H| <= C_H (1+t) and |H'| <= C_H' (1+t) with explicit rationals. |M(x)| <= C x^theta gives fixed-field rate theta - 1/2. J takes both signs (J(4) > 0 > J(6)).

CROSSING.statement: A transverse physical crossing has a source-fixed branch. Signed crossing separation, fixed-width isolation, stationary profile and the duration of negative intervals constrain a hypothetical off-line response; a one-sided duration or separation estimate is still needed.

DELAY.statement: Actual delayed arithmetic replay pays the tail at O(sqrt(x)). The middle delayed amplification and its two signs still carry a zero displacement; fitted relative signed-gain estimates would be circular.

DIVISOR_FIBRE_LIMIT.statement: Exact divisor-fibre inversion of a rough interval places its original signed charge in the coefficient at 1. A nonempty interval excluding 1 cannot be represented by nonnegative whole-fibre weights.

DIVISOR_PREFIX.statement: Same-group fixed primitive ratios, individual prime echoes and finite or superpolynomial sieve masks have explicit paid sectors. Smoothing before squaring can erase the critical fluctuation; restore the full signed variance and unrestricted translated history in any transfer.

FINITE_K5.statement: The K5 exact-rational Gram test and two genuine-source Arb probes give finite sign and Schur information with slot conditioning. Separate synthetic zero, ablation and weight controls cannot become an all-K estimate.

FINITE_NATIVE_CHECK.statement: Exact native enumeration distinguishes the first clipped positive charge from the first whole positive coarse cell after 2²⁰. On the observed final slab the moving and frozen masks give different energies.

FIXED_SIEVE.statement: At fixed Y=10⁷ the complete different-rough-part covariance has a one-sided sign criterion, with a numerical all-horizon diagonal lower and a conditional countersign height implication. The required eventual/cofinal signs have not been proved.

FORMAL_COORDINATES.statement: The checked odd-to-even shift is injective and its image is the center-evaluation kernel. At K=5 the odd/even dimensions are one/two. The physical charts are nonunitary. No positivity or unconditional source upper follows.

FORMAL_GAP.statement: The paper one-sided survivor criterion still requires an independent upper and a complete kernel-checked transfer on the actual source. The separate A-X implication already accepts an all-damping upper for the actual prime field.
